Class ProcessingBehavior

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.machine.ProcessingBehavior
All Implemented Interfaces:
MachineBehavior
public final class ProcessingBehavior extends Object implements MachineBehavior
A ready-made behavior for recipe machines: start the first recipe (registration order) whose inputs are available, run it, deliver outputs, and optionally push outputs to a neighbor. Sleeps whenever there is nothing to do.
  • no startable recipe → SchedulerState.WAITING
  • running without per-tick costs → SchedulerState.SCHEDULED until done
  • running with per-tick costs → SchedulerState.ACTIVE
  • outputs do not fit (here or at the push target) → SchedulerState.BLOCKED, retried every retryTicks
